title: kill aura
features: kills all enemies in a 35 magnitude radius of you
script:
local game = game
local players = game:GetService("Players")
local localPlayer = players.LocalPlayer
local character = localPlayer.Character
local replicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
local cd = 0
runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(delta)
    character = localPlayer.Character
    local tool = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
    if cd > 0.005 and tool then
        for _,v in workspace.Mobs:GetChildren() do
            if v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and v:FindFirstChild("Enemy") and (character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Position - v.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.Position).Magnitude < 35 and v.Enemy.Health > 0 and tool then
                replicatedStorage.GameRemotes.DamageEvent:FireServer(v.Torso,v.Enemy,tool)
            end
        end
        cd = 0
    end
    cd += delta
end)
